title: Binecone
tagline: Binecone Project for HackFS 2024.  - Data DAO Project based on FVM
description:
Binecone Project for HackFS 2024.

"A huge vector database based on blockchain that embeds and retrieves data for AI and LLM."

Binecone is an innovative service that combines blockchain and vector database to safely manage and quickly retrieve data.
Binecone specializes in AI model training, data retrieval optimization, and high-performance data processing.

* How it works.
1. Connect your wallet.
2. Input data to store and click the store button.
3. Input data to query and click the search button.
4. Then you can retrieve nearest topK data from vector database.

* Bineone's features

- Data DAO Project based on FVM, IPFS, Filecoin, and IPC.

- Massive data for the public goods and public purpose.

- Open source project and collaboration.

-  Convergence of Blockchain + AI + Data

- More detail please see https://binecone.com
how_its_made:
This project will be built on Ethereum, Filecoin, and IPC.
To provide smooth service, we plan to actively utilize external resources and APIs, and also use cloud services when necessary.

The use of other blockchain projects for the interface of blockchain services, data analysis, and data management will be actively promoted.
Maximizes the advantages of the Web 3 project through the convergence of various blockchain projects.
We aim to create a project that smoothens the transition from existing Web 2 services to Web 3 services so that users can easily use it without any hesitation.
